puzzle.name: CountDigits demo
puzzle.comment: Normal sudoku rules apply. Each coloured region lists digits in its corner. The cell marked # in the same colour is that region's counter: its digit equals how many cells of the region hold one of the listed digits. Two CountDigits elements carry the same rule -- the app's built-in and a pruning one; exactly one is enabled. Flip them in the Elements panel (the three-dot menu, Disable / Enable) and solve again to compare.
